# WorkoutPlanMaker

Free browser-based adult workout templates and macro estimates. No account. Inputs stay in the current tab. Not medical advice.

- [Get Your Personalized Workout Plan](https://yyu447672-tech.github.io/workoutplanmaker/): Build a free personalized workout plan, calorie estimate and daily macros from 8 questions. No signup. Your answers stay in your browser.
- [Macro Calculator](https://yyu447672-tech.github.io/workoutplanmaker/macro-calculator.html): Calculate daily protein, fat and carbs for free. Enter a calorie target or estimate energy needs. All calculations stay in your browser.
- [Privacy Policy](https://yyu447672-tech.github.io/workoutplanmaker/privacy-policy.html): How WorkoutPlanMaker processes fitness inputs locally, handles print files and uses Google Analytics for visits without sending body details.
- [TDEE Calculator](https://yyu447672-tech.github.io/workoutplanmaker/tdee-calculator.html): Calculate TDEE and BMR free with Mifflin-St Jeor, Harris-Benedict and Katch-McArdle. No sign-up; your fitness inputs stay in your browser.
- [BMI Calculator](https://yyu447672-tech.github.io/workoutplanmaker/bmi-calculator.html): Check your BMI free: enter height and weight to get your BMI, category and healthy weight range. No sign-up, instant result in your browser.
- [Calorie Deficit Calculator](https://yyu447672-tech.github.io/workoutplanmaker/calorie-deficit-calculator.html): Plan your calorie deficit free: set your weight-loss goal and pace to get your daily calorie target and target date. No sign-up, instant result.
